task.title: Make empty remote conversations delete reliably
task.source: Live Raspberry Pi user report and browser reproduction
task.classification: remote runtime, storage performance, optimistic cache reconciliation, and user-data deletion

coreClaim: Deleting an empty conversation does not rewrite unrelated message and swipe collections, and an ambiguous remote-runtime timeout cannot restore conversation rows that storage already deleted.
rootCause: Empty chat cleanup always entered a full atomic messages and message-swipes replacement even when neither collection contained a row for the chat. Separately, useDeleteChat treated the browser's 30-second remote-runtime deadline as a definite server failure and restored complete pre-delete React Query snapshots, resurrecting stale rows after the server completed or had already deleted them.

inScope: Empty-chat message and swipe cleanup fast path
Remote-runtime timeout reconciliation for the conversation delete mutation
Focused storage and React Query regressions
Live Pi cleanup and post-merge deletion verification
outOfScope: Changing the browser's 30-second remote request deadline
Changing conversation deletion confirmation or memory-cleanup choices
Changing storage formats, migrations, or import/export behavior
Changing optimistic rollback for definite server failures
riskFlags: conversation roleplay and game shared cleanup

claimBoundary.coreClaim: A chat with no owned messages or swipe sidecars skips the expensive atomic rewrite, while an ambiguous browser deadline keeps the optimistic removal until authoritative queries reconcile.
claimBoundary.riskType: storage deletion, transaction latency, and stale client-state resurrection
currentPathsOrFormats: React Query chats list, summaries, and group caches
legacyPathsOrFormats: Existing chats in conversation, roleplay, game, and legacy visual-novel modes use the same storage cleanup path.
Existing swipe sidecars with a matching chatId but no parent message remain cleanup candidates.
outOfScopeClaims: This change does not promise every storage operation finishes within a fixed deadline.
This change does not hide definite delete failures.
This change does not alter message, swipe, chat, or memory schemas.

contractLaneGate.brokenContract: An empty chat delete performed a multi-collection replacement with no changed rows, while an ambiguous transport deadline was treated as authoritative rollback evidence.
contractLaneGate.producer: Rust chat-owned message cleanup and remote-runtime ApiError
contractLaneGate.impliedContract: Empty deletes avoid unrelated write work, and client state reconciles ambiguous destructive requests from storage rather than stale snapshots.
contractLaneGate.actualEnforcement: The Rust owner inspects chat ownership inside the atomic boundary without requesting mutable rows on a no-op; FileStorage skips replacement when every AtomicCollectionRows entry remains read-only. The catalog owner skips snapshot restoration only for ApiError details code remote_runtime_timeout; onSettled invalidations remain authoritative.
contractLaneGate.primaryOwnerDetail: src-tauri decides whether message and swipe mutation is needed; src/features owns the catalog mutation's optimistic rollback semantics.
contractLaneGate.wrongLaneFixToAvoid: Do not only increase the timeout, suppress all delete errors, or remove atomic cleanup for chats that own messages or stale sidecars.

positiveRows.claim: A read-only atomic transaction does not replace its target collection.
positiveRows.evidence: The storage-owner modification-time regression passes, and the 138-test marinara-storage suite is green.

positiveRows.claim: An empty chat with no messages or sidecars does not replace either large collection.
positiveRows.evidence: The focused modification-time regression failed before the fast path and passes after it.

positiveRows.claim: An ambiguous remote timeout does not resurrect a removed conversation row.
positiveRows.evidence: The focused QueryClient regression failed before timeout classification and passes after it for both list and summary caches.
The existing useDeleteChat onSettled invalidations are unchanged for list, summary, and optional group queries.

contradictionRows.claim: A stale sidecar for an otherwise empty chat must still be deleted.
contradictionRows.evidence: delete_empty_chat_still_removes_matching_stale_sidecars passes and retains only an unrelated sidecar.

contradictionRows.claim: A chat with messages must retain atomic message and sidecar cleanup.
contradictionRows.evidence: delete_message_rows_for_chats_with_swipes_removes_sidecars_by_deleted_message_id passes, including a stale sidecar chatId removed by its deleted parent message ID.

contradictionRows.claim: A definite server failure must still restore prior client state.
contradictionRows.evidence: The companion hook regression passes for a storage_error ApiError and restores both list and summary snapshots.

legacyDefaultRows.claim: Conversation, roleplay, and game storage cleanup semantics remain shared.
legacyDefaultRows.evidence: No mode branch, collection format, command signature, or delete response changed.

legacyDefaultRows.claim: Existing remote and desktop API callers remain compatible.
legacyDefaultRows.evidence: No storageApi signature, HTTP dispatch, Rust command input, or response shape changed.

untestedRows: Final production-image timing and a real disposable empty-conversation delete will be verified after the merged revision is deployed to the Pi.

ownedFacts.description: Four New Conversation rows were visible in the live Pi sidebar while only one existed in the server chat inventory.
ownedFacts.evidence: Browser data-chat-id inspection found four IDs; remote storage inventory found only b09fe85d-d930-4b81-a599-b56e30efda02.

ownedFacts.description: The remaining persisted empty chat had zero messages and zero characters.
ownedFacts.evidence: The remote chat and message inventory reported no message rows for the chat.

ownedFacts.description: Repeated storage_delete requests produced heavy block writes and mostly lacked completion logs.
ownedFacts.evidence: Live container logs showed many starts, one 8133 ms completion, and container block I/O increasing beyond 1.3 GB while messages.json and message-swipes.json totaled about 25 MB.

userActionCopy.description: Conversation deletion remains destructive. Export any conversation that must be retained before confirming deletion.
userActionCopy.source: Open the conversation and use its export action.
userActionCopy.destination: A user-selected folder outside De-Koi's application data directory.
userActionCopy.action: Verify the exported JSON exists at the destination before confirming conversation deletion.

manualBlockers.item: Post-merge live Pi delete timing and browser persistence
manualBlockers.reason: Local regressions prove both owner contracts. Exact target-device timing and the 30-second reload result require the merged production images.

verification.baselineEvidence: pnpm check passed. pnpm test passed 2366 tests with 1 skipped. The final Rust workspace run passed 1370 tests including every changed-path regression; one unrelated parallel sprite timeout test failed and passed immediately in an exact single-thread rerun. The full 138-test marinara-storage suite passed.

notes: The live browser ghosts were already absent from storage, so no additional user conversations were deleted during diagnosis.
The Pi currently runs main revision 3ab18e3774c74159f1cccb0c2f10dcf016f83810; post-merge deployment will advance it to the exact merge revision.

An earlier pre-final Rust run's health_writable_probe_is_opt_in_and_cached and sprite_sheet_cleanup_obeys_generation_timeout failures were unrelated parallel timing cases; exact single-thread reruns passed 1/1 each. The final run had only the same sprite timeout case, and its exact rerun passed again.
